subject.title: fix: preserve subagent delivery after lock stalls

question: Should this PR require live after-fix gateway/session proof before merge, or is the focused Azure before/after regression proof enough for this private-session failure mode?
rationale: The PR is a plausible narrow bug fix, but external-PR proof is still test-only after the patch and the protected maintainer label means ClawSweeper should not treat that proof gap as automatically waived.

options.title: Require rebase plus live proof
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, rerun focused agent tests and required CI, then require redacted live gateway/session proof before merge.

options.title: Explicitly waive live proof
options.body: Maintainers can accept the Azure before/after regression proof for this private-session failure mode, but the waiver should be visible before merge.

options.title: Split the stale diagnostic half
options.body: If current main's session-lock code has drifted too much, keep only the durable-delivery repair here and move diagnostic expansion to the active lock cluster.

recommendation.title: Require rebase plus live proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, rerun focused agent tests and required CI, then require redacted live gateway/session proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history makes steipete the strongest routing candidate for subagent delivery and session-lock lifecycle decisions.
